world_scope_review.result: No once-failed permanent-latch defect identified in reviewed ProcessReader/WorldFrameScope/invalidateSample control flow.
evidence: beginWorldFrame first ends the previous scope, subscribes demand, and attempts acquisition on every call.
endWorldFrame submits accumulated requested pages and resets binding/completeness.
Incomplete candidate causes invalidateSample to clear sampler caches and restore last committed state; RAII still ends the scope.
The saved log contains repeated display samples counters, which are incremented after complete succeeds; a continuously incomplete scope cannot explain those observations.
world_scope_review.secondary_issue: The new same-frame/same-UI fast path refreshes only camera and can retain stale visibility/layout/viewport-readiness state while the exact token remains fixed. It does not alone explain a minutes-long session with advancing control frames.
